import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int N, K, MOD, MAX_VAL, BIT_COUNT[];
    static int F[];
    static int T1[][] = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static int T2[][] = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static int T3[][] = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static long MOD_SQ;
    static long TMP[][] = new long[20][MAX_N];
    static long FACT[], INV_FACT[];

    static long mod_exp(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init_factorials() {
        FACT[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            FACT[i] = FACT[i-1] * i % MOD;
        INV_FACT[MAX_VAL] = mod_exp(FACT[MAX_VAL], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            INV_FACT[i] = INV_FACT[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
    }

    static int ceil_pow2(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void fwht(int arr[], int len, boolean inv) {
        long buf[] = new long[MAX_N];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) buf[i] = arr[i];
        
        if (inv) {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buf[i + step + j] = (buf[i + step + j] - buf[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        buf[i + step + j] = (buf[i + step + j] + buf[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            arr[i] = (int)(buf[i] % MOD);
            if (arr[i] < 0) arr[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static void reduce(long x[]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= MOD_SQ) x[i] -= MOD_SQ;
        }
    }

    static void convolve() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(T1[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(TMP[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            T1[BIT_COUNT[i]][i] = F[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(T1[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    TMP[i + j][idx] += 1L * T1[i][idx] * T2[j][idx];
        
        reduce(TMP);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                T3[i][idx] = (int)(TMP[i][idx] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(T3[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            F[i] = T3[BIT_COUNT[i]][i];
    }

    static void square() {
        int buf[][] = new int[20][MAX_N];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(TMP[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j)
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                    TMP[i + j][idx] += 1L * T2[i][idx] * T2[j][idx];
        
        reduce(TMP);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
                buf[i][idx] = (int)(TMP[i][idx] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(buf[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(T2[i], 0);
        
        for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx)
            T2[BIT_COUNT[idx]][idx] = buf[BIT_COUNT[idx]][idx];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(T2[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD_SQ = 1L * MOD * MOD;
        
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(mod_exp(K, N));
            return;
        }
        
        F = new int[MAX_N];
        BIT_COUNT = new int[MAX_N];
        FACT = new long[MAX_N];
        INV_FACT = new long[MAX_N];
        
        F[0] = 1;
        MAX_VAL = ceil_pow2(N + 1) - 1;
        init_factorials();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            BIT_COUNT[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i)
            T2[BIT_COUNT[i]][i] = (int)INV_FACT[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(T2[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        
        int orig_k = K;
        while (K > 0) {
            if ((K & 1) == 1) convolve();
            K >>= 1;
            if (K > 0) square();
        }
        
        long ans = (mod_exp(orig_k, N) - FACT[N] * F[N] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
